result.edit: The test fails at cycle=9 with incorrect Gray code output (0101 vs expected 0111). The issue is that gray_out is being assigned twice - once in the Gray-to-binary conversion block and again in a separate always block. This creates a race condition. Removing the redundant assignment in the first always block ensures the output is updated consistently in one place, maintaining the correct 2-cycle increment timing while preserving the hold behavior.
